about: How every trigger is accounted for. A trigger is tested by a scenario in tests/scenarios, or listed here: with `test`, the unit test that covers it (it must exist); else `why` no scenario can fire it (out of scope, not wired, not implemented). Sub-actions the engine doesn't run need no entry: one test checks they're all skipped. todo: what is still to test (connections and polling, see docs/TESTING.md); it only shrinks.

triggers.why: Streamer.bot 1.0.7 drops these triggers when it loads an action (checked with dev/sb-oracle.py): no Streamer.bot action can use them. Raw Action/Sub-Action/Completed are WebSocket events only
